scenario.title: The shag-pile special
scenario.description: The cloth feels like carpet. Choose a pot that earns its travel.

curriculum.lesson: Welcome to Broken table. Each table has visible faults that affect the actual shot. This slow cloth takes speed from every ball: compare a short pot with the longer option, then balance enough pace to reach the pocket against a cue-ball finish you can repeat. After your shot, replay the identical launch on normal cloth to see what the extra drag changed.
curriculum.takeaway: Slow cloth makes distance expensive for both balls. Judge the whole journey before adding power.

briefing.gotcha: A stronger stroke can reach the pocket and still overshoot its finish. Read the pace and spin together.

conditions.name: Slow cloth
conditions.description: Thick, tired cloth drains speed everywhere. Longer routes need more pace.
